general.game_folder.tip: Select the path to a valid Forza Horizon 6 install for model and texture loading. Steam - ForzaHorizon6, Xbox - ForzaHorizon6/Content

general.autosave_interval.tip: Minutes between autosave attempts. Set to 0 to disable autosave.

theme.layer_background.tip: Background color in Layers widget previews.

tools.display_anchors.tip: Keeps transform handles visible while a transform drag is in progress.

tools.nudge_small.tip: Distance moved by an arrow key press in Move or Transform.

tools.nudge_big.tip: Distance moved by Shift plus an arrow key in Move or Transform.

tools.separate_opacity_skew.tip: Skew anchor will be removed in favour of separate Skew tool.

editor.visibility_borders.tip: Shapes outside the borders might not render properly ingame.

editor.transformed_previews.tip: If on will generate previews with tranformations even for sole shapes.

editor.livery_texture_scale.tip: Livery texture multiplier in the 3D preview widget, 4x - ingame user car, 1x - ingame other players cars.

editor.value_wheel.tip: Allows the mouse wheel to change values in Properties widget.

editor.discard_model.tip: Unloads the current car model when another livery project is opened.

editor.load_car_textures.tip: May degrade performance but allows for better car detail in 3D preview.

advanced.differential_budget.tip: Maximum number of shapes the solver may place. Higher values allow more complete fills but can take longer.

advanced.differential_adam_iterations.tip: Maximum Adam optimization steps for each candidate transform. More steps can improve fitting at a higher runtime cost.

advanced.differential_restarts.tip: Additional jittered optimizer starts for ordinary candidates. More restarts can escape poor local solutions but increase runtime.

advanced.differential_spill_weight.tip: Penalty applied to candidate area outside the desired region. Larger values pull shapes farther inward.

advanced.differential_eps_area.tip: Remaining uncovered area considered negligible, measured in square canvas units. Larger values stop sooner.

advanced.differential_eps_gain.tip: Minimum new area a shape must cover, measured in square canvas units. Larger values reject small cleanup shapes.

advanced.differential_eps_spill.tip: Outside-envelope area allowed by unweighted legalization, measured in square canvas units. Weighted contour mode keeps the envelope exact.

advanced.differential_adam_learning_rate.tip: Adam optimizer step size. Values that are too large may overshoot; values that are too small may converge slowly.

advanced.differential_inactivity_timeout.tip: Stops a fill after this many seconds without coverage or pruning progress. Set to 0 to disable the timeout.

advanced.differential_boundary_tolerance.tip: Sampling and matching tolerance for contour boundaries and authored features, measured in canvas units.

advanced.differential_outward_margin.tip: Expands the legal placement envelope beyond the desired region by this distance in canvas units, making edge coverage easier.

advanced.differential_area_window_ratio.tip: Keeps candidates whose area gain reaches this fraction of the best gain before quality ranking. Values near 1 favor raw coverage.

advanced.differential_tversky_alpha.tip: Weight assigned to outside area in Tversky similarity. Larger values rank spill more harshly.

advanced.differential_tversky_beta.tip: Weight assigned to missing area in Tversky similarity. Larger values rank gaps more harshly.

advanced.differential_feature_weight.tip: Priority given to preserving exposed hard corners and smooth contour junctions relative to area gain.

advanced.differential_feature_restarts.tip: Number of feature-aligned optimizer starts. More starts can reproduce contour landmarks more reliably but increase runtime.

advanced.differential_seed.tip: Seed for optimizer jitter. Set to 0 to derive a stable seed from the fill geometry.

advanced.differential_router.tip: Limits optimization to shapes that resemble the current residual. Disabling it evaluates a broader catalog and is slower.

advanced.differential_gpu.tip: Uses CUDA optimization or Direct3D legalization when available before falling back to CPU-only work.

advanced.differential_weighted_contour.tip: Ranks and validates candidates using contour distance and authored-feature preservation in addition to covered area.

system.icon_pack.tip: Change application and .3so files icons, restart needed.

system.file_association.tip: Registers this executable as the handler for .3so project files for the current user.
